name: powerpages-traditional-site
description: Power Pages Traditional (non-code) site toolkit — noun-named pp-* skills for provisioning, building, editing, integrating, and securing Power Pages sites on the enhanced Dataverse data model (mspp_* tables + powerpagecomponent): website lifecycle via the pac power-pages CLI, web pages, web templates, web files, server logic, Liquid, Web API, table permissions, security review (with pac power-pages scans), and cache flush. The traditional-site counterpart to Microsoft's code-site plugin.
